script_text: Cancer, the Moon rules this Water sign and this week it unleashes a tide you cannot ignore. Early week, Mars squares Neptune in your 12th House on Monday, blurring your intuition — skip decisions until Wednesday. By Tuesday, a Jupiter trine activates your ruling Moon in the 4th House, grounding emotions and restoring inner peace. Mid-week turning point, Venus enters your 5th House on Wednesday, flooding your love life with opportunity and creative sparks — this is the shift everything changes. Late week, Saturn sextiles Pluto in your 8th House on Thursday, unlocking shared finances and career leverage through collaborators. Wednesday is your power day because Venus entering your 5th House ignites romance and confidence. Monday is your worst day because Mars square Neptune disguises reality and drains motivation. Before Friday, speak your career ambitions aloud — the stars align to reward bold self-assertion. Follow for daily updates.
